scope: Offline candidates only, not scene or task acceptance
discovery_broadphase: Vectorized conservative source AABB overlap; every counted intersection still requires exact FCL
endpoint_sphere_screen: AABB lower bounds only prune safe pairs; close pairs use exact source FCL at unchanged margin+3mm

posture_adaptation_discovery.scope: Source initial robot and door/environment stay mandatory. Old redundant endpoint and later baseline arm postures are not constrained when enabled. Same Cartesian target, full on-plan endpoint validation, actual approach/pull and all final gates remain mandatory.

invariant_gripper_screen.scope: Discovery only: fixed Cartesian policy uses measured baseline articulated gripper poses. Redundant arm postures remain unconstrained. Source hand plus original margin+3mm, support+5mm and distal goal proxy checks prune impossible placements; full same-target on-plans and actual dynamics still required.

planning_proxy_discovery_screen.scope: Also check initial and invariant distal goal spheres against the same per-collider padded AABBs used by cuRobo for glass/barrier, including baseline extra padding. This is a conservative discovery filter, not source-intersection evidence or final acceptance.

approach_reference_geometry: All original source robot shapes and conservative execution envelopes; necessity still uses physical source hulls/primitives only.

invariant_conservative_envelope_screen.scope: Conservative placement discovery only: full initial robot plus fixed Cartesian distal arm/gripper/finger proxies. Not source intersection evidence or global infeasibility. Original final margins and all paired/physical acceptance gates unchanged.
